name: serpentine
description: Indoor cycling on real roads: a home-made Zwift for smart trainers.
author: Chris Perkles

scripts.test: node scripts/test-devices.ts && node scripts/test-hub.ts && node scripts/test-drivetrain.ts && node scripts/test-fit.ts && node scripts/test-strava.ts && node scripts/test-training.ts && node scripts/test-workouts.ts && node scripts/test-api.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run app:typecheck && npm test
scripts.app: npm run build && node electron/build.mjs && electron .
scripts.app:dist: npm run build && node electron/build.mjs && electron-builder --mac --publish never
